title: A part lookup result from the shared list shows Part Library as its source
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LOOKSRC-01) is active at {Location-A}, with quantity 5.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open, for a ZZAUTOTEST customer, with a line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL lookup source line").
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Work Orders.
  2. Open {Work-order-1}.
  3. In the Parts row of {Line-1} click + Add Part.
  4. In New Part Request, type {Part-A} in Part Number.
  5. Read every result offered for {Part-A}.
  6. Close the dialog without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The result for {Part-A} that comes from the shared list (not the one showing "Inventory Qty: 5" with its unit) shows "Part Library" as its source. No result says "Catalog".
  • Step 6: The dialog closes and nothing is added to {Line-1}.
